headline: 这是我的个人网站，以后还会继续更新。
headlineEn: Not a template, but a personal expression kept in motion.
intro: 这里放着我做过的项目、看过的番、玩过的游戏，还有一只能互动的食蜂操祈。
introEn: PaperFrame's personal website experiment, bringing projects, media memories, technical learning and a Shokuhou Misaki character interface into one browser space.

facts.label: 主要技术
facts.value: HTML · CSS · JS · NODE · THREE.JS · VRM

eras.title: 从空白文件开始
eras.description: 第一版由 PaperFrame 纯手工编写。Windows 桌面、粒子连线、个人信息窗口和留言表单，记录了这个项目最初、直接而真实的样子。
eras.descriptionEn: V1.0 was written manually by PaperFrame. Its Windows desktop, particle links, profile window and message form preserve the project's earliest and most direct form.

eras.title: 从网页扩展成个人世界
eras.description: 第二版由 PaperFrame 负责方向、审美、内容与最终决策，并使用 AI Agent 辅助代码重构、测试和迭代。AI 是开发工具，网站表达与取舍仍来自作者本人。
eras.descriptionEn: PaperFrame directs the visual language, content and final decisions of V2.0, with AI agents assisting code refactoring, testing and iteration. AI is a development tool; the expression and choices remain the creator's.

motion.title: 食蜂操祈的动作是怎么做的？
motion.titleEn: Motion is not simply downloaded and played.
motion.description: 角色动作先在我做的 VRMA Lab 里调整骨骼、节奏、视线和表情，调好以后再放进网站。
motion.descriptionEn: The site's VRMA motions are selected and refined in PaperFrame's VRMA Lab—bones, timing, gaze and expressions are tuned before integration through the character state machine.

credits.name: とある科学の超電磁砲　食蜂操祈
credits.author: 模型作者：のーり

credits.noteEn: Creator credit is read from embedded VRM metadata. Redistribution is marked as disallowed; permission or a replacement model is required before a public V2.0 release.
